skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and recognizing basic knowledge about controlling
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand and recognize the necessary basic knowledge about controlling, internal control, operational control, and strategic control.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Setting up control systems and control centers in enterprises
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand, recognize, and apply setting up control systems and control centers in enterprises.
Students understand, recognize, and apply strategic control of business operations.
Students have independent work skills, discipline, teamwork skills, communication skills, and leadership skills.
Students have the ability to independently study, accumulate, and improve their professional knowledge, adapt to different working environments, and be autonomous in their work.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing phenomena and identifying problems related to control
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can integrate knowledge and skills to analyze phenomena, identify problems related to control, determine the causes of problems in specific organizations/businesses, and solve practical issues flexibly with leadership and management skills.
